mapper.select: SELECT 'LEGACY_TEXT_CONTENT' AS source_type, source.id::text AS data_source_id, content.version AS content_version, content.version::bigint AS source_revision, NULL::bigint AS sync_artifact_id, NULL::varchar AS quality_status, NULL::varchar AS quality_rule_set_version, NULL::timestamptz AS published_at, content.object_key, content.sha256, content.byte_size, content.media_type, content.created_at AS content_created_at FROM knowledge_data.text_data_source source JOIN knowledge_data.text_data_source_content content ON content.tenant_id = source.tenant_id AND content.knowledge_space_id = source.knowledge_space_id AND content.data_source_id = source.id AND content.version = source.published_content_version WHERE source.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND source.knowledge_space_id = #{knowledgeSpaceId} AND source.status = 'PUBLISHED' UNION ALL SELECT 'GOVERNED_SYNC_ARTIFACT' AS source_type, source.id::text AS data_source_id, NULL::integer AS content_version, artifact.source_revision, artifact.id AS sync_artifact_id, publication.quality_status, publication.rule_set_version AS quality_rule_set_version, publication.published_at, artifact.content_object_key AS object_key, artifact.content_digest AS sha256, artifact.content_byte_size AS byte_size, artifact.content_media_type AS media_type, artifact.content_created_at FROM knowledge_data.published_sync_artifact publication JOIN knowledge_data.governed_data_source source ON source.tenant_id = publication.tenant_id AND source.knowledge_space_id = publication.knowledge_space_id AND source.id = publication.data_source_id JOIN knowledge_data.sync_artifact artifact ON artifact.tenant_id = publication.tenant_id AND artifact.knowledge_space_id = publication.knowledge_space_id AND artifact.id = publication.artifact_id WHERE publication.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND publication.knowledge_space_id = #{knowledgeSpaceId} AND source.status <> 'RETIRED' AND publication.source_version = ( SELECT MAX(current_publication.source_version) FROM knowledge_data.published_sync_artifact current_publication WHERE current_publication.tenant_id = publication.tenant_id AND current_publication.knowledge_space_id = publication.knowledge_space_id AND current_publication.data_source_id = publication.data_source_id ) ORDER BY source_type, data_source_id, source_revision

SELECT tenant_id, knowledge_space_id, id, source_snapshot_digest, chunk_policy, embedding_deployment_id, embedding_deployment_revision, embedding_configuration_id, embedding_configuration_revision, embedding_catalog_entry_id, embedding_catalog_entry_revision, embedding_dimension, status, version, build_digest, chunk_count, failure_code, created_by, created_at, ready_at, activated_at, superseded_at FROM knowledge_data.index_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND knowledge_space_id = #{knowledgeSpaceId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, knowledge_space_id::text AS knowledge_space_id, index_version_id::text AS index_version_id, attempt FROM knowledge_data.index_build_job WHERE available_at <= #{now} AND ( status = 'PENDING' OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until <= #{now}) ) ORDER BY available_at, created_at, index_version_id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1
